- `pattern_fit`: **A+B** — published fix spans handler/OpenAPI+generated plumbing, service secret policy, both provider implementations and a provider-consistency check in a different package, plus one leftover route (hostless/schemeless repo URLs skip `providerFromRepoURL`).
- Strongest lever: the case split a solver must reproduce is on the far side of generated code — X-Hub-Signature only reaches `verifyHMACSHA256` if `detectGitProviderFromParams`, the OpenAPI header list and `models.gen.go`/`server.gen.go` are all changed, so a fail-closed edit to `bitbucket.go:26` alone blocks forgery but rejects every real Bitbucket webhook (pinned tests even assert token-equality as "correct").
- Biggest red flag: none of the twelve definitions hold (`[]`) — 3 backport commits, multi-site, no GPU/network need, and the exception is explicitly documented at `bitbucket.go:20-22`, so `protection_documented_without_exceptions` does not apply.
